description: Single and two storey rear extension; Partial demolition of attached garage to create side access with wooden gate; Replacement entrance door in front elevation; Replacement windows in front, side and rear elevations; Installation of windows in front and side elevations (Demolition of rear extension)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="line-height: 107%; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The proposed
two-storey rear extension by reason of its bulk and width would give rise to an
obtrusive form of development which would impair the proportions of the host
dwellinghouse and would detract from the established&nbsp;and
prevailing&nbsp;pattern of development in the area, contrary to the high
quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),
Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021),&nbsp;Policy GR1 of Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041)
and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide
(2010).</span></p>

<p>The proposed two storey rear extension by reason of its depth and width adjacent to the shared boundary would result in an unacceptable and unreasonable level of harm to the residential amenities of the occupiers of No.92 Woodlands. The development would be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021),&nbsp;Policy GR1 of Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>
